subject: Arcadia Property Group: Outstanding Items for Draw #13 and Earlier Requests
body:
Robert,

I'm following up on several items we have requested and have not yet received.

First requested April 23, 2025:
- Third-party inspector's report for Q1 2025 (Draw #13)
- GC's updated construction schedule showing the revised completion date (Draw #13)
- Executed lien waivers from the MEP subcontractor (Draw #13). Conditional waivers are acceptable.
- Updated pre-lease summary: executed leases or LOIs with tenant names, square footage and proposed rent per square foot

First requested August 6, 2024:
- Revised construction schedule reflecting the HVAC delay (Draws #10/#11)

First requested June 28, 2024:
- Written documentation of the HVAC delay and the GC/HVAC subcontractor change-order dispute

First requested January 17, 2024:
- Complete draw documentation per our draw checklist for all future draw requests

Please send these by [DATE]. If something is holding any of them up, let me know a time this week for a call so we can work through it.

Thanks,
Tom
